title: CAPS Discovered Candidates Artifact
description: A signed report emitted by the caps-crawler repo and proposed (via PR) for inclusion under caps-spec/discovered/<date>.json. Each artifact records candidate tracking parameters observed in a single crawl run. caps-spec maintainers review the PR against the false-positive principle, accept/reject/scope the candidates, and merge — never auto-merge.

discovered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the crawl run completed (e.g. 2026-05-03T18:42:00Z).

crawler_version.description: Git SHA of the caps-crawler commit that produced this artifact. Lowercase hex, 7-40 chars. Provides a reproducible link back to the exact crawler binary.

corpus.description: Lowercase hostnames visited during this run. The rotating corpus list lives in caps-crawler; this field captures the actual subset visited so a reviewer can reproduce the run scope.

param.description: Parameter name observed in the post-load URL but absent from the original href. Case-sensitive.

first_seen_on.description: Lowercase hostname where this candidate was first observed during the run.

injected_by.description: Identifier of the redirect chain or script that injected the candidate (e.g. wrapper id, script hostname). Used by reviewers to attribute and triage.

occurrence_count.description: Number of distinct first-party domains in this run on which the candidate was observed. Higher count = stronger signal.

candidates.description: Candidate tracking parameters surfaced by this run. An empty array is permitted (a clean run is still a meaningful signed receipt).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature, hex-encoded (lowercase, 64 bytes -> 128 chars). Computed over the canonicalized JSON of this object with the `signature` field removed. Canonicalization: JSON.stringify with object keys sorted alphabetically at every level. Verifier key: crawler-pubkey.txt at the root of this repo.
